name: beyond_get_context
description: Get current session context including Platform project, branch, permissions, compact model-only schema information, last_checkout, and relevant_documents when available. Use beyond_get_project_overview or beyond_get_model with detail_level='full' for detailed data. Use beyond_get_document for specific documents and fetch all HUMAN-authored documents if they are not already in memory.

detail_level.description: compact returns model-only schema information with entities/processors/attributes/transformations counts per model; name-only returns logical name, physical name, ID, and counts in hierarchy; full returns the cached full context.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
